notes:
REF-BM-02: Title, description, and favicon are collected, but preview images are not.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate URLs are rejected and the existing card is focused when visible, but editing is not opened and filtered-out duplicates are not surfaced.
REF-BM-10: Tag inputs are plain comma-separated text fields without existing-tag autocomplete.
REF-BM-14: Tag search uses tag: syntax rather than #tag syntax.
REF-BM-15: The parser lacks AND/OR/NOT operators and general parenthesised groups; it only offers implicit AND and tag:(a|b) alternatives.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action interface/API.
REF-BM-21: There is no action targeting all bookmarks in the current filtered collection.
REF-BM-23: Notes can be written and displayed, but they are rendered as plain text rather than Markdown.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML/PDF snapshot support exists.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot support exists.
REF-BM-26: Bookmarks have no archived state or archive action.
REF-BM-27: Delete is visibly permanent, but no reversible archive operation exists to distinguish from it.
REF-BM-28: There is no archived-bookmarks view.
REF-BM-29: Bundles or reusable saved filters are not implemented.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is not implemented.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is not implemented.
REF-BM-32: There is no personal display-settings facility or persisted default sort/items/font-size configuration.
